summary.text: Michelle Williams is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 127 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Republican incumbent Charles Cunningham.

According to her campaign website, Williams spent 12 years as a teacher in the Houston Independent School District, and her priorities include repealing school vouchers and funding public education, affordable healthcare, flood mitigation and restoring women's reproductive rights.

sources.title: Michelle Williams for State Representative, District 127
